report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Mt. Pleasant Water Users Association (Report Date June 25, 2026)

sources_described: Purchased treated surface water: Mt. Pleasant Water Users Association purchases treated water from San Jose Water, delivered through a metered connection serving the residential area near 3855 Higuera Road, San Jose, northeast of White Road - an area primarily served by SCVWD (Valley Water) imported surface water. An assessment of San Jose Water's sources was completed in December 2002; the imported surface water is considered most vulnerable to agricultural and urban runoff, recreational activities, livestock grazing, and residential and industrial development (page 1). Tables 3-5 reproduce San Jose Water's 2025 Annual Water Quality Report results for its 'VW Surface Water' source (page 4 note).

extraction_notes: Consecutive system (all water purchased from San Jose Water, CA4310011). Printed pages equal PDF pages (1-4). Tables 3-5 reproduce San Jose Water's 2025 results for the 'VW Surface Water' source with 'Level Detected' plus Min/Max columns; the report does not label the level an average, so value_basis is 'level detected' with average null and Min/Max stored as range. Only one source column, so source_group is null. Lead and copper (Table 2) are the association's own 2024 tap samples (5 sites). The report lists two contact numbers (408-472-9372 on page 1, 408-605-0012 in the language statements). San Jose Water's full report is extracted separately in data/ccr/CA4310011.json.
